title: Chapter 21 Lord Zach, The Servant Of God
content:
Chapter 21 Lord Zach, The Servant Of God

"Lao Zhang, how's business going these two days?"

Chef Zhang quickly replied: "It's okay in the past two days. With the currency, more and more players are ordering takeout."

I tell you quietly: "Some players will eat 100 copper coins in one meal. Seeing how generous they are, I estimate that they have at least 1 gold coin in their hands."

Wang Shuo smiled and said nothing, I have 70 gold coins in my backpack, will I tell you?

But Wang Shuo thought again, there is no guarantee that others also understand the principle of keeping wealth secret, but the imagination of those rich people really cannot be complimented.

"For a meal, the worst is only 100 copper coins!"

If you think so, it will be difficult.

Wang Shuo stopped thinking and explained: "It's not that easy. I opened several bronze treasure chests in a row to get these gold coins."

"Old Zhang, I've prepared the plates and bowls. How much is your payment? Are we going to trade in several installments?"

"Haha! No need to go to so much trouble. Before, I thought it was a bit difficult to collect enough money. Thanks to the rich players, I have also collected it."

There are 1,000 plates and bowls in total, 10 copper coins each, which is 10,000 copper coins.

Wang Shuo was surprised. Lao Zhang was also hiding his secrets. Just such a small item had already reached the amount of 1 gold coin, which put a little pressure on Wang Shuo.

Not simple!

The two quickly completed the deal.

[Gold coin +1, plate -500, bowl -500]

When a player has 100 copper coins, they will be automatically converted into silver coins, and the silver coins will also be converted into gold coins, which is very convenient for players.

After the money and goods were settled, Lao Zhang gave Wang Shuo a pork rib rice, which made Wang Shuo instantly feel that Lao Zhang was a pretty good person.

While eating pork rib rice, Wang Shuo exclaimed instantly: "This Lao Zhang is quite good at doing business!"

Wang Shuo is now thinking about how to maximize his advantages.

At this time, the sun outside is getting more and more fierce, and the temperature difference between day and night is huge, but compared with the acid rain weather, it is already excellent.

Another hour later, all Wang Shuo's clay was made into adobe bricks and tiles. He now has 3,600 adobe bricks and 20,160 tiles.

Among the materials used to upgrade residential buildings, there are still gaps in wood and stone.

So he browsed the trading houses.

Use water in exchange for 500 wood and 400 stone.

Wang Shuo silently thought about "upgrading residential buildings".

[Residential buildings: wood 804/500, adobe bricks 3600/2000, tiles 20160/1000, stone 745/400, energy crystal 12/1]

[Are you sure you want to upgrade your house to a private residence? 】

"Sure."

[Wood-500, adobe-2000, tile-1000, stone-400, energy crystal-1]

[The residential house is under construction and will take 4 hours]

Wang Shuo looked at the system prompts calmly, thoughtfully.

Now the security of the territory has become Wang Shuo's top priority. In order to protect the property he worked so hard to build, the beasts in the swamp must be eradicated.

Wang Shuo opened his backpack and took out the blueprints for making leather armor and leather boots. After studying them, he got the "synthesis formula".

[Leather armor: 5 animal skins + 4 hemp ropes]

[Leather boots: 1 animal skin + 2 hemp rope]

[It has been detected that you have high-grade crocodile skin, which can be used to make fine leather armor and fine leather boots. 】

The crocodile skin he had now could be used to make two sets of leather armors and leather boots, and he silently said "make" in his mind.

[High-grade crocodile leather armor +1, crocodile leather armor +1, crocodile leather boots +2]

[Due to your explosive character, you got high-grade crocodile leather armor, gold quality. 】

Another "critical attack" made Wang Shuo feel very happy.

[High-grade crocodile leather armor: gold quality, constitution +10, defense +20, durability 100/100. Equipment requirements, basic physical fitness 10. 】

(Gold quality, invulnerable, put it on, mom will no longer worry about losing blood if you get beaten!)

It's very good and powerful, but it's a pity that I can't wear it now.

[Crocodile Leather Armor: Excellent quality, Constitution +5, Defense +10, Durability 20/20. 】

[Crocodile leather boots: excellent quality, agility +3, durability 20/20]

Compared with the fine grade and the gold grade, the attributes are twice as bad. However, Wang Shuo cannot equip the high-grade ones yet, so he can only put on the fine leather armor and put on the leather boots, and he immediately feels different.

First of all, it is very comfortable and has a certain degree of warmth. After running around the house, I felt that my face was deformed by the wind.

It took a while before I got used to the current speed and was able to move and retract freely.

Just when Wang Shuo was in a good mood, in another space, a little old man was staring at the huge screen in front of him, talking to himself from time to time.

This little old man, about 50 years old, has a thin build, tall cheekbones, and a slight goatee. If he were standing at the gate of the community and people asking for directions, they would definitely think that he was the old gatekeeper.

As if he had a premonition, he turned around and saw a man wearing dark gold armor walking over quickly from a distance.

"Great God's Servant Lord Zach, has this newbie's survival trial begun?"

The man with the aura of a king restrained all his aura when facing the little old man, and his attitude was very respectful.

He knew that this little old man liked to be called "Lord Servant of God Zach".

"Hey, you came just in time, we've just started!"

With a wave of his hand, the screen in front of him suddenly showed countless survivors like Wang Shuo, struggling to explore in the heavy fog.

"Tiezhu, is your territory in trouble? I advised you not to call it this name at the beginning, Sunset City, Sunset Lord, you think it's so unlucky!"

Lord Sunset sweated violently. Apart from this old man, no one could call him by this name.

Because they are all dead.

"Lord Zach! I've said it many times, please don't call me by this name. My name is Wang Zhu now, or you can call me Xiao Wang." The Lord of Sunset City couldn't help complaining, but he didn't dare to really say it. angry.

"Haha, okay then, let's call him Xiao Wang."

The Lord of Sunset City showed a resentful look.

"Sunset City is now surrounded by enemies on all sides. My priest told me that if I come to you, I might be able to gain a chance of survival in the upcoming war."

"You know, I can't interfere too much in the war between you."

"I don't dare to ask Lord Zach to help me resolve the crisis. I only ask that you can allocate the strongest survivors to my territory."

The little old man was silent for a while and was about to speak.

At this time, another majestic lord wearing a red cloak came over.

"See the respected Lord Servant of God Zach."

"Well, it turns out to be the Iron-Blooded City Lord! Are you also here for this novice trial?"

"Yes, it's time to add a new batch of fresh blood to my territory."

The Iron-Blooded City Lord also said respectfully.

"Hmph, do you want to steal people from me again this time?" Sunset City Lord said angrily.

"How can we say that supplementing the citizens is robbery? Everyone depends on their ability. After all, it is their voluntary choice." The iron-blooded city lord said with a smile.

"Now that they're all here, let's take a good look!" the little old man said calmly, threw two tokens out, and then looked into the mist without saying a word.

"Yes, Lord Servant of God Zach."

The two took the token, bowed their hands to the little old man, and retreated.

With this token, they can check the trial status at any time, and are qualified to select survival trial participants.
